pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

Victory always belongs to diamond hands. Many come and go, all craving massive returns in the short term — nothing comes that easy. I’ve been keeping an eye on some former top holders in our ecosystem. They cut their losses, hopped into countless other tokens, and ended up seeing their assets shrink drastically. This market is brutal. We may have taken heavy losses, but as long as we refrain from reckless trading and hold firm to our conviction, even if we don’t strike it rich in the end, we won’t wipe out our accounts. Most tokens are just short-term hype with no real underlying value. This cruel market punishes everyone, yet it rewards every diamond hand. We don’t need huge holdings. Keep only what you can afford to lose, keep working hard, and wait for the reward.

I’ve gone all in, because I need one win. Don’t follow my lead. I’m a gambler, but I’m also an ultra diamond hand.

comment.comment:
As the #1 Meteora launchpad, Meteora is not passively tolerating Ember — it benefits directly and disproportionately:

1.	Fee & volume engine: Ember ranks among the top launchpad by 30-day volume.

2.	Sticky, high-quality liquidity: Locked LP + innovative fee designs (Gravity, self-deepening) create better post-graduation markets than typical bonding-curve dumps. This improves overall Meteora pool quality and attracts more serious volume.

3.	Expansion of the addressable market: Ember pushes “pair with any stock/RWA/meme.” This drives activity into Meteora’s DLMM and DAMM infrastructure for tokenized equities — a high-growth vertical Meteora already dominates on Solana.

4.	Synergy with Meteora’s current narrative: Meteora just unveiled DLMM Pro (customizable launch engine). $MET has been ripping 30–70% on the news. Ember is already the purest, most battle-tested implementation of Meteora’s launch stack. As attention flows back to Solana launch infra, the projects already generating real volume and fees on it (like Ember) get the leverage.

5.	Aligned incentives: More Ember launches → more fees to Meteora → stronger $MET narrative → more builders and capital into the ecosystem → more launches on Ember. Flywheel!!!
